fixes.walletAuthorization: The 18 reachable wallet-profile prefixes require the existing signature-bound login. Public room lists remain available; independent seat/account protocols are excluded.
fixes.twoStonesDefense: The normalized payload wallet must match ws.authorizedWallet before the socket receives subscriptions.
fixes.replay: Persist a SHA-256 fingerprint of match ID, authorized wallet, request ID type and value outside gameState, auditLog and proof inputs. Keep every accepted request up to the 44-action bound. Old absent metadata remains valid; malformed present metadata and identifier-less mutations are rejected.

androidProtocolMatch.identities: Two synthetic account sessions, seat tokens and ephemeral P256 actor keys

tests.command: PG_BINDIR=<local PostgreSQL 18 binary directory> node server/scripts/free-multiplayer-smoke.cjs
tests.fixtureFailureResolved: An initial 13-case run had one force-drop/connection teardown failure. Consumers now close before normal DROP; asynchronous database errors are asserted absent. No application logic changed to bypass a failed assertion.
tests.fixtureIsolation: The local PostgreSQL validator rejects query parameters, fragments, non-PostgreSQL schemes and effective-host overrides before opening a Pool. Cleanup is registered before CREATE/init. The runtime environment is allowlisted, environment-file loading and external fetches are disabled, and funded/mint/settlement/indexer/anchor gates are false.

independentReviews.runtime: No blocking issue found. The limits for prior unrecorded request IDs and asynchronous persistence remain documented.
independentReviews.infrastructure: Two concrete fixture findings were corrected and re-reviewed; no remaining blocker was identified.

limits: Pre-upgrade action IDs were not recorded and cannot be retrospectively deduplicated.
Legacy Two Stones acknowledgment precedes asynchronous persistence. The restart test waits for the actual stored row and does not establish durability for a crash before that save.
Replay hardening applies to Two Stones. The broader prefix guard establishes authorization, not full gameplay or replay acceptance for every catalogue game.
The Android-protocol completion is a signed resignation, not checkmate. Local socket clients do not prove physical APK or real-network acceptance.
No production deployment or live free-game acceptance was performed.
